title: Route M3.1 authoring product lane to dedicated exact-head CI
purpose: Recognize the exact M3.1 pedagogical-quality product branch in the legacy Learn-it Next CI router and delegate product semantics to its dedicated exact-head workflow without weakening unknown-branch fail-closed behavior.
invariants: Only the legacy Learn-it Next CI router and this work-package file may change.
All pre-existing Atlas M1, Wave A, workflow_dispatch and post-merge routes remain semantically unchanged.
The exact M3.1 product branch is the only new recognized branch.
The M3.1 route is delegation-only and does not claim to execute M3.1 product semantics.
Delegation requires the product PR to contain the canonical M3.1 work package, the dedicated exact-head product workflow and an authoring/v2 product change.
Every other unknown product-relevant pull-request branch remains fail-closed.
Rename/copy-aware product relevance logic in the ci-router path remains unchanged.
Repository governance, PR scope, product code, product tests and canonical authorities are untouched.
requiredEvidence: Learn-it Next CI self-audit PASS on the CI-WP-005 branch.
Static diff proves only one route_branch case and one m3-1-delegated execution block are added.
ci-router unknown-product fail-closed checks remain present and unchanged.
M3.1 delegated block requires exact branch, exact work-package ID/issue, dedicated workflow path and authoring/v2 change.
adversarialTests: Exact M3.1 branch with required workflow, work package and authoring/v2 change delegates successfully.
M3.1 branch missing dedicated workflow fails.
M3.1 branch missing canonical work package fails.
M3.1 branch without authoring/v2 product change fails.
Any other unknown branch with authoring/v2, contracts or apps/learnit-next product changes still fails closed.
Existing rename-out and copy-out product relevance self-tests remain unchanged.
Existing Atlas M1 and Wave A branch route strings remain unchanged.
nonGoals: Executing or accepting M3.1 product semantics in the legacy router.
Changing branch protection or required checks.
independentReview: Repository governance and PR scope provide independent repository-level review.
The workflow executes its existing ci-router self-test on this workflow-only change.
After merge, product PR #264 must rerun the exact M3.1 delegated route and dedicated product CI on the same rebased head.
rollback: Revert the single delegated route block and CI-WP-005 metadata; unknown M3.1 product branches return to the previous fail-closed behavior.
